lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The spatial arrangement follows a semi-orthogonal grid with inter-blob spacing increasing along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes. These intersections are most clearly defined in the mid-lateral section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.
